---
title: "Mission — a population neuroscience showcase"
---

## Purpose

Create an elegant scientific demonstration of neurons, networks and population responses for the Flux website.

## Deliverable

One editable project with a manuscript, thirty-three source plots from three generators, two dense journal-style Figure compositions and four native animated slides.

## Data

Only public data from the sources documented under data/. Anatomical and activity panels may have different source specimens.

## Visual direction

White scientific panels; ink labels; one eight-hue direction wheel shared by every panel; individual observations alongside population summaries; figures composed densely, the way a person lays out a journal plate.

## Next steps

Refine layouts, add observations or additional source records, and improve the story directly in Flux.
